faqs.q: Do I need a permit to operate a short-term rental?
faqs.a: If you rent a dwelling unit, including a single-unit, duplex, multiplex, or multifamily dwelling unit, mobile home, or any portion of such dwellings, for a period of less than 30 nights and a minimum of 2 nights, a short-term rental permit is required. If you only rent for 31 or more nights at a time, then no permit is required.
